tickets.text: Horizon: earnings 2026-11-17 falls inside the 10-session hold; the ticket should say the position is carried through the report.

The pull-in to the Creek precondition is not my test; after the red bar my signal is the close back over that bar's high (C14, C27), with or without a pull-in. structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE. Would clear: trigger close_above:bar_high on D, a daily close back above the red bar's high.

WATCH with a pull-in to the Creek: the break is made (structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE, elder_pattern ACCELERATION, rs_rank_pct 92.67); my position system buys it, it does not wait for a pullback (C26). Would clear: trigger trade_above:bar_high on D with no pull-in precondition, buy stop 1 tick over yesterday's high (C27).
